column1: # The tropical forest (Ronald approved the biome; Plants wires on tropical-trees): Brazil nut (emergent), cacao (understorey), liana. Leaves tinted (grey); liana own colours.
# BLOCK_LIKE per image: t_brazil log_mesquite,log_mesquite_top,planks_mesquite,leaves_oak; t_cacao log_dogwood,log_dogwood_top,planks_oak,leaves_oak; t_sap sapling_mesquite,sapling_oak,kelp

column3: log_brazil_nut|log|Brazil nut tree bark: a dead-straight smooth trunk, grey to grey-brown bark (#4a4642 #5e5a54 #77716a #8e877e #a59d92) with long fine vertical fissures running the full height, a few faint pale lichen flecks
column4: log_brazil_nut_top|end|Brazil nut log cut end: pale reddish-brown wood (#8a5a44 #a8705a #c08a70 #d09a80) with fine growth rings, inside a thin grey bark rim (#5e5a54 #77716a)
column5: planks_brazil_nut|built|Brazil nut planks: pale reddish-brown wood planks (#5e3a2c #7e5040 #9a6650 #b47e64 #c89678) with fine straight grain, four boards
column6: leaves_brazil_nut|leaves|Brazil nut leaves: large leathery oblong leaves 6-9 px long, dark glossy green (#24401c #34582a #487236 #5e8a44) each with a pale glossy highlight line, overlapping, magenta gaps 25-35%

column3: log_cacao|log|Cacao tree bark: smooth thin grey-brown bark (#4e463c #665c50 #7e7266 #968a7c), smooth with few fissures, and pale grey-green lichen patches (#a8ae96 #c0c4ae) here and there
column4: log_cacao_top|end|Cacao log cut end: light brown wood (#9a7a56 #b49470 #c8ac88) with fine growth rings inside a thin grey-brown bark rim (#665c50 #7e7266)
column5: planks_cacao|built|Cacao planks: light brown wood planks (#5a4630 #7a6044 #967a58 #b09470 #c4aa84) with soft straight grain, four boards
column6: leaves_cacao|leaves|Cacao leaves: big drooping elongated leaves 8-10 px long, green (#2e4a22 #426430 #5a7e3e #729a4e), a few young leaves a subtle reddish-bronze (#6e5034 #866040), hanging downward, magenta gaps 25-35%

column3: sapling_brazil_nut|plant|A young Brazil nut sapling: a thin straight grey stem with four large dark green oblong leathery leaves at the top, about 18 px tall
column4: sapling_cacao|plant|A young cacao sapling: a thin grey-brown stem with three big drooping elongated green leaves, one young leaf reddish-bronze, about 16 px tall
column5: liana|plant|A woody hanging liana (a climbing vine): one twisted rope-like stem 2-3 px thick, brown-green (#4a3a26 #64503a #7a6a44 #5e6a3a), running from the TOP edge to the BOTTOM edge and touching both at the same column (so stacked tiles join into one rope), swinging gently left and right within the middle third, with 3-4 small heart-shaped green leaves (#3e6a2c #5a8a3e #74a24c) on short stalks; magenta all around
